# Input

A labeled field for a short typed value.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Multi-brand</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-input--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:light" title="Input examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-input--docs">Open Input in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-input--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:multi-brand--aster;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Multi-brand:** Sign-up and account fields.

- **Use it when:** A name, email, phone number or other one-line answer.
- **Not when:** Long text (textarea), or a closed choice (radio group, select or checkbox).

Instead:

- [Textarea](./textarea.md): Several lines.
- [Select](./select.md): A known list of options.

## How Multi-brand uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Field label or column header</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> type.label</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> type.caption</div></div><div class="cap">Labels stay readable in every brand.</div></div></div>

## Words

- Shared structure: object, state, next step.
- Brand tone lives in headlines and marketing copy, not in errors.
- Errors and confirmations read the same in every brand.
- Use: Get started, Plan, Order. Avoid: Brand-specific words in errors, Jargon.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Save
- `content.action.cancel`: Cancel
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Get started

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] A visible label, never a placeholder as the only label. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add input
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Variables

Every token Input reads, from its code: the variable, the semantic token it aliases, and where that ends in the theme.
